summary: Iteration 48 — Frontend-only verification of IslandHop's three showcase innovations. /technology hero + 3 cards render with data-testids; footer 'Technology' link navigates correctly. /admin/dispatch (as tracyfortune admin) loads dispatch-unassigned-panel (20 orders), dispatch-drivers-panel (1 online driver 'Route Driver', 4.8), shows 8 dispatch-order-btns, 12 'No pickup coordinates' notes, and clicking 'Auto-dispatch all' (dispatch-run-all-btn) returned dispatch-message = 'Dispatched 8 of 20 order(s).' Non-admin customer is correctly gated on /admin/dispatch with an 'Access restricted' screen. OFFLINE SYNC end-to-end WORKS: with browser context.set_offline(True) + window.dispatchEvent('offline'), clicking cart-checkout-btn enqueues the order to localStorage 'islandhop_offline_orders_v1' (length=1), clears islandhop_cart_v1 to {}, navigates to /dashboard?offline_saved=1, and offline-sync-banner reads 'Offline — 1 order saved, will send when back online'. On reconnect (set_offline(False) + 'online' event) the queue flushed to 0 within ~8s via POST /api/orders and the banner hid after the synced toast. Logo renders unbroken in header + footer (0 broken imgs).
critical_code_review_comments: OfflineSyncManager.flush correctly halts the loop when navigator.onLine drops mid-flush (or no HTTP response) and only permanently drops items on real server rejections — good behaviour for rural T&T.
MultiCart.placeAll wraps createOrder in try/catch with isNetworkError as a fallback for mid-checkout network drops. Clean.
AdminDispatch route is properly protected (customer sees 'Access restricted, only for admin/agent'). Backend admin-only enforcement was already curl-verified this session.
TechnologyPage cards have consistent data-testids (tech-routing / tech-offline / tech-dispatch and *-cta) and CTAs correctly deep-link to /driver-dashboard, /businesses, /admin/dispatch.
Pre-existing warnings in console (ReferralBanner probe 401 on fresh customers, and admin /api/admin/users ObjectId 500 from prior iteration) — unrelated to this review scope.

To exercise the DriverRouteCard result UI (ordered stop list, percent-saved, distance/time saved, Start-navigation btn), seed Mongo: register a customer, insert a drivers doc {id:<uuid>, user_id:<uid>, status:'online', rating:4.8, vehicle_type:'car', current_location:{lat,lng}}, set users.user_type='driver', insert >=2 orders with driver_id=<that id>, status='picked_up', service_type='food' and delivery_address:{latitude,longitude,full_address} at distinct POS/San Juan/Arima coords, then log in as that driver and click driver-optimize-route-btn. Backend GET /api/driver/route/optimize already verified (percent_saved=59.5). CartProvider shape in localStorage is { [vendor_id]: {vendor_id, vendor_name, service_type, delivery_fee, items:[{id,name,price,quantity}], ...} } — do NOT use a {vendors:[]} wrapper (CartProvider crashes on Array.reduce over undefined items otherwise).
